jobs.title: P2618 - Global Value & Access Lead
jobs.description:
Are you a strategic Market Access and HEOR professional ready to shape the commercial and clinical destiny of an innovative pipeline? Debiopharm is seeking a Global Value & Access Lead to define and drive the long-term Global Value & Access strategy across our entire pipeline portfolio.

If you’re ready to make a real impact — this is your moment.

The role is based at our Headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland.

Global Value & Access Lead

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland

Department: Business and Program Leadership & Management; Global Value & Access

Contract: permanent role, full-time.

Your Mission.

In this dual-impact role, you will blend high-level strategic oversight, cross-functional collaboration, and hands-on team leadership. You will lead the value proposition for our assets from early development through to commercialization, while mentoring a team member to foster a high-performing culture.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Market Access & HEOR

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Relationship Management

Leadership, Governance & Departmental Excellence

## Requirements
- Experience: 5 to 10 years including proven experience in Global Market Access, Pricing, and HEOR within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, preferably overseeing multi-asset pipelines.
- Leadership Skills: Demonstrated experience or strong capability to manage, mentor, and develop junior talent, fostering professional growth and strategic thinking.
- Technical Expertise: Deep understanding of health economic modeling (cost-effectiveness, budget impact), patient-reported outcomes (COAs), and global pricing dynamics.
- Business & Financial Acumen: Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into revenue forecasts and strategic commercial perspectives.
- Strategic & Collaborative Mindset: Excellent communication skills to effectively convey the risks and benefits of complex methodologies to the wider business and build strong cross-functional relationships.

## Benefits
- Being part of a company where innovation, collaboration, and impact aren’t just values — they’re how we work every day
- Partner with teams across disciplines, at the forefront of oncology and anti-infective development
- An inclusive and respectful workplace — proud to be Equal-Pay certified
- Grow in a culture that values people, purpose, and performance
- A chance to grow, share, and shape the future of healthcare

titleByLocale.it: P2618 - Piombo di valore e accesso globale

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei un professionista strategico di Market Access e HEOR pronto a plasmare il destino commerciale e clinico di una pipeline innovativa? Debiopharm sta cercando un Global Value & Access Lead per definire e guidare la strategia Global Value & Access a lungo termine in tutto il nostro portafoglio pipeline. Se siete pronti a fare un impatto reale — questo è il vostro momento. Il ruolo ha sede nella nostra sede a Losanna, in Svizzera. Piombo di valore e accesso globale Ubicazione: Losanna, Svizzera Dipartimento: Business and Program Leadership & Management; Global Value & Access Contratto: ruolo permanente, a tempo pieno. La tua missione. In questo ruolo dual-impact, si fonderà la supervisione strategica di alto livello, la collaborazione interfunzionale, e la leadership di team hands-on. Condurrai la proposta di valore per i nostri beni dal primo sviluppo fino alla commercializzazione, mentre tutorerai un membro del team per promuovere una cultura ad alto rendimento. Principali responsabilità Accesso al mercato strategico e HEOR Gestione della collaborazione e delle relazioni Leadership, Governance & Departmental Excellence
• Requisiti - Esperienza: da 5 a 10 anni tra cui l'esperienza comprovata in Global Market Access, Pricing e HEOR nel settore farmaceutico o biotecnologico, preferibilmente supervisionando le tubazioni multi-asset. - Leadership Skills: Esperienza dimostrata o forte capacità di gestire, mentore e sviluppare il talento junior, promuovere la crescita professionale e il pensiero strategico. - Competenza tecnica: profonda comprensione della modellazione economica sanitaria (economicità, impatto di bilancio), dei risultati riportati dai pazienti (COA), e delle dinamiche di prezzi globali. - Business & Financial Acum: Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di tradurre dati complessi in previsioni di reddito e prospettive commerciali strategiche. - Mindset strategico e collaborativo: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione per trasmettere efficacemente i rischi e i benefici di metodologie complesse al business più ampio e costruire forti relazioni interfunzionali. Vantaggi - Facendo parte di un’azienda in cui innovazione, collaborazione e impatto non sono solo valori – sono come lavoriamo ogni giorno - Partner con team di discipline, in prima linea di oncologia e sviluppo anti-infettivo - Un posto di lavoro inclusivo e rispettoso - orgoglioso di essere Equal-Pay certificato - Crescere in una cultura che valorizza le persone, lo scopo e le prestazioni - Una possibilità di crescere, condividere e plasmare il futuro della salute

jobs.title: P2604 - Principal Clinical Pharmacologist
jobs.description:
Debiopharm is privately-owned Swiss biopharmaceutical company committed to research in Oncology and Infectious diseases to improve patient outcomes and quality of life. Debiopharm International SA aims to develop innovative therapies via our unique “development only” business model, acting as a bridge between disruptive discovery products and patient access in international markets. At Debiopharm you will be at the forefront of the fight against cancer and infectious diseases through working on innovative medicines for patients. Efficacy is our mode of action, saving lives our collective target. Join our team at Debiopharm where together, we innovate, we impact, and we grow.

For our Clinical Pharmacology & Pharmacometrics Unit organization based at our Headquarters in Lausanne, we are looking for a

Principal Clinical Pharmacologist

In this role, you will be the leader for developing the clinical pharmacology scientific strategy for assigned projects in Oncology and/or Infectious diseases. To that aim, you will manage, conduct and supervise clinical pharmacology activities to add value, support, and accelerate the development of Debiopharm’s innovative medicine.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Debiopharm è un'azienda biofarmaceutica svizzera privata impegnata nella ricerca in Oncologia e malattie infettive per migliorare i risultati del paziente e la qualità della vita. Debiopharm International SA ha lo scopo di sviluppare terapie innovative attraverso il nostro unico modello di business “solo sviluppo”, che funge da ponte tra prodotti di scoperta dirompenti e l’accesso dei pazienti nei mercati internazionali. A Debiopharm sarete in prima linea nella lotta contro il cancro e le malattie infettive, lavorando su farmaci innovativi per i pazienti. L'efficacia è il nostro modo di agire, salvando vive il nostro obiettivo collettivo. Unisciti al nostro team di Debiopharm dove insieme, innovare, impattiamo e cresciamo. Per la nostra Farmacologia Clinica & Farmacometrica Organizzazione unità con sede a Losanna, stiamo cercando un Farmacia clinica principale In questo ruolo, sarai il leader nello sviluppo della strategia scientifica di farmacologia clinica per progetti assegnati in Oncologia e/o malattie infettive. A tal fine, gestirai, conduci e supervisionerai le attività di farmacologia clinica per aggiungere valore, supporto e accelerare lo sviluppo della medicina innovativa di Debiopharm.

Debiopharm International SA zielt darauf ab, innovative Therapien über unser einzigartiges Geschäftsmodell „Entwicklung nur“ zu entwickeln, das als Brücke zwischen disruptiven Discovery-Produkten und Patientenzugang in internationalen Märkten fungiert. Bei Debiopharm werden Sie an der Spitze des Kampfes gegen Krebs und Infektionskrankheiten stehen, indem Sie an innovativen Arzneimitteln für Patienten arbeiten. Effizienz ist unsere Handlungsweise, die Rettung von Leben unser kollektives Ziel. Begleiten Sie unser Team in Debiopharm, wo wir gemeinsam innovativ sind, wir wirken und wachsen. Für unsere Klinische Pharmakologie & Pharmakometrie Einheitsorganisation mit Sitz in Lausanne suchen wir nach einer Hauptklinik für Pharmakologie In dieser Rolle werden Sie führend für die Entwicklung der klinischen Pharmakologie wissenschaftlichen Strategie für vergebene Projekte in der Onkologie und/oder Infektionskrankheiten sein. Zu diesem Zweck werden Sie die klinischen Pharmakologieaktivitäten verwalten, leiten und überwachen, um Mehrwert, Unterstützung und die Entwicklung der innovativen Medizin von Debiopharm zu beschleunigen.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Debiopharm est une société biopharmaceutique suisse privée engagée dans la recherche en oncologie et maladies infectieuses pour améliorer les résultats des patients et la qualité de vie. Debiopharm International SA vise à développer des thérapies innovantes grâce à notre modèle d'affaires unique de développement, agissant comme un pont entre les produits de découverte perturbateurs et l'accès des patients sur les marchés internationaux. Chez Debiopharm, vous serez à l'avant-garde de la lutte contre le cancer et les maladies infectieuses en travaillant sur des médicaments innovants pour les patients. L'efficacité est notre mode d'action, sauvant des vies notre cible collective. Rejoignez notre équipe à Debiopharm où ensemble, nous innovons, nous avons un impact et nous nous développons. Pour notre pharmacologie clinique et pharmacométrie Organisation de l'unité basée à notre siège à Lausanne, nous cherchons Pharmacologue clinique principal Dans ce rôle, vous serez le chef de file pour l'élaboration de la stratégie scientifique de pharmacologie clinique pour les projets assignés en Oncologie et/ou maladies infectieuses. À cette fin, vous gérerez, dirigerez et superviserez des activités de pharmacologie clinique pour ajouter de la valeur, soutenir et accélérer le développement de la médecine innovante Debiopharm.

jobs.title: P2612 - Senior Manager Statistical Programming
jobs.description:
Together, we innovate, we impact, we grow !

At Debiopharm, every step we take is guided by one purpose: improving the lives of people affected by cancer and infectious diseases. As a privately-owned Swiss biopharmaceutical company, we’re driven by science, but above all, by the people behind every treatment — the patients and their families.

Through our unique “development only” model, we bring forward promising therapies and transform them into treatments that can reach those who need them most, faster.

We are currently looking for a motivated and collaborative professional to join our Biostatistics and Data Management (R&D) Department based at our Headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland as

Senior Manager, Statistical Programming

Permanent role | Lausanne, Switzerland

Your Mission:

As the Senior Manager of Statistical Programming, you will provide strategic leadership for Statistical and Clinical Data Science Programming. You will be the driving force behind our digitalization strategy, implementing cutting-edge data science technology and AI adoption to streamline clinical data processing and analysis. Beyond strategy, you will lead a talented team of programmers and data scientists to ensure the highest quality of deliverables for our clinical projects.

Your Key
• Responsibilities

· Leadership & Management: Manage a team of statistical programmers, overseeing resource planning, talent acquisition, and professional development.

· Strategic Digitalization: Lead the roadmap for AI adoption and new technical solutions for integrating and reporting clinical data.

· Operational Excellence: Accountable for the quality and timelines of all programming deliverables (datasets, TLFs) for study reports and integrated summaries.

· Vendor Oversight: Provide technical guidance to CRO partners to ensure efficient, integrated project reporting and adherence to standards.

· Compliance: Ensure all activities strictly adhere to GCP, SOPs, and regulatory requirements for electronic data submissions.

· Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Biostatistics, Data Management, IT, and Clinical Development functions.

Come azienda biofarmaceutica privata svizzera, siamo guidati dalla scienza, ma soprattutto dalle persone dietro ogni trattamento: i pazienti e le loro famiglie. Attraverso il nostro esclusivo modello "solo sviluppo", portiamo avanti terapie promettenti e le trasformiamo in trattamenti che possono raggiungere coloro che ne hanno più bisogno, più velocemente. Permanent role | Lausanne, Switzerland

· Leadership & Quality: Manage, mentor and develop the CSV team, ensuring high-quality delivery across all portfolio initiatives, identify areas for process improvement, change management and assist with audit planning / CAPA formulation.

jobs.title: P2617 - Senior Clinical Data Manager
jobs.description:
Together, we innovate, we impact, we grow

At Debiopharm, every step we take is guided by one purpose: improving the lives of people affected by cancer and infectious diseases. As a privately-owned Swiss biopharmaceutical company, we’re driven by science, but above all, by the people behind every treatment — the patients and their families.

Through our unique “development only” model, we bring forward promising therapies and transform them into treatments that can reach those who need them most, faster.

Are you passionate about advancing science and improving lives? We are currently looking for a driven, passionate and collaborative professional to join our Biostatistics and Data Management department based at our Headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland as

Senior Clinical Data Manager

Permanent role | Location: Lausanne, Switzerland

Your Mission

As a Senior Clinical Data Manager, you will be accountable for the quality and timelines of data management activities across assigned clinical studies. You will play a pivotal role in ensuring that complete, accurate, and consistent clinical data is available to support our internal decision-making processes. Whether managing internal tasks or overseeing activities outsourced to external providers, you are the guardian of data integrity and quality.

Key Responsibilities

## Requirements
- Education: Scientific or technical background, ideally at a university level. In addition, any Project Management certification would be a plus.
- Experience: At least 10 years in clinical data management, working in matrix organization with at least one previous and solid experience in pharmaceutical industry and supporting Phase 1 to 3 studies. Project Management experience, an asset.
- Technical Expertise: Strong experience with various EDC systems and   first experience or proficiency automating activities with AI.
- Leadership: Proven track record in leading data management studies and teams to deliver high-quality, regulatory-compliant databases.
- Skills: Excellent organizational, planning/coordination, proactivity and communication skills. Tech savvy, especially with Digital tools and AI
- Languages: Fluent in English; knowledge of French is a distinct asset.

## Benefits
- Being part of a company where innovation, collaboration, and impact aren’t just values — they’re how we work every day
- Partner with teams across disciplines, at the forefront of oncology and anti-infective development
- An inclusive and respectful workplace — proud to be Equal-Pay certified
- Grow in a culture that values people, purpose, and performance
- A chance to grow, share, and shape the future of healthcare

descriptionByLocale.de: Bei Debiopharm ist jeder Schritt, den wir unternehmen, von einem Ziel geleitet: der Verbesserung des Lebens von Menschen, die von Krebs und Infektionskrankheiten betroffen sind. Als privat geführtes Schweizer biopharmazeutisches Unternehmen sind wir von der Wissenschaft angetrieben, vor allem aber von den Menschen, die hinter jeder Behandlung stehen – den Patienten und ihren Familien. Durch unser einzigartiges „Development Only“-Modell bringen wir vielversprechende Therapien voran und wandeln sie in Behandlungen um, die schneller diejenigen erreichen können, die sie am meisten benötigen. Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, die Wissenschaft voranzutreiben und das Leben zu verbessern? Wir sind derzeit auf der Suche nach einer engagierten, leidenschaftlichen und strategischen Führungskraft für die Verstärkung unserer Abteilung für Biostatistik und Datenmanagement an unserem Hauptsitz in Lausanne, Schweiz, als Leiterin für Biostatistik und Datenmanagement. Bei Debiopharm werden wir von einer einzigen Mission angetrieben: für Patienten zu entwickeln. Als Leiter der Abteilung Biostatistik und Datenmanagement spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle bei dieser Mission, indem Sie ein engagiertes Team hochqualifizierter Fachleute leiten, um allen unseren klinischen Programmen modernstes Fachwissen zur Verfügung zu stellen. In dieser Schlüsselrolle entwerfen und implementieren Sie die innovative Datenstrategie, die unserer klinischen Entwicklungspipeline zugrunde liegt, und stellen die höchsten Standards der wissenschaftlichen Genauigkeit und Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften in allen Versuchen und Studienphasen sicher, die für unsere globalen Produktregistrierungsbemühungen von grundlegender Bedeutung sind. Ihre Mission Wir sind mehr als nur eine Checkliste mit Fähigkeiten. Wir suchen jemanden, der unser Engagement für die Wissenschaft zielgerichtet teilt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Debiopharm, chaque étape que nous entreprenons est guidée par un seul objectif : améliorer la vie des personnes touchées par le cancer et les maladies infectieuses. En tant qu’entreprise biopharmaceutique suisse privée, nous sommes motivés par la science, mais surtout par les personnes derrière chaque traitement : les patients et leurs familles. Grâce à notre modèle unique de « développement uniquement », nous proposons des thérapies prometteuses et les transformons en traitements qui peuvent atteindre plus rapidement ceux qui en ont le plus besoin. Êtes-vous passionné par l’avancement de la science et l’amélioration des vies ? Nous recherchons actuellement un leader motivé, passionné et stratégique pour rejoindre notre département de biostatistiques et de gestion des données basé à notre siège social à Lausanne, en Suisse, en tant que responsable des biostatistiques et de la gestion des données. Chez Debiopharm, nous sommes animés par une mission unique : développer pour les patients. En tant que responsable des biostatistiques et de la gestion des données, vous jouerez un rôle central dans cette mission en dirigeant une équipe dédiée de professionnels hautement qualifiés pour fournir une expertise de pointe à tous nos programmes cliniques. Dans ce rôle clé, vous concevrez et exécuterez la stratégie de données innovante qui sous-tend notre pipeline de développement clinique, garantissant les normes les plus élevées de rigueur scientifique et de conformité réglementaire dans tous les essais et phases d'études, éléments fondamentaux de nos efforts mondiaux d'enregistrement de produits.
• Votre mission Plus qu'une liste de compétences, nous recherchons quelqu'un qui partage notre engagement envers la science avec détermination.
